Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Lawrence
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 320 as introduced provides for a two percent salary increase to state employees effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2022. The personnel costs of the several state agencies will increase by an estimated $43.3 million in fiscal year 2022, with an estimated $13.6 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Lawrence
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 04/26/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 320 as passed the House of Representatives provides for a two percent salary increase to state employees effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2022. The personnel costs of the several state agencies will increase by an estimated $43.3 million in fiscal year 2022, with an estimated $10.4 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
